html:
Gunu is the name the map gives to an Aboriginal people of the border country between New South Wales and Queensland, along the lower Warrego River.

Little is written about them under this name. The name is close to Kurnu, a people of the Darling River whose speech was a dialect of Paakantyi, and the two may be linked. Neighbours on the map include the Muruwari to the east and the Kunja to the north. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: Gunu is the name the map gives to an Aboriginal people of the border country between New South Wales and Queensland, along the lower Warrego River.
